label: Before repairs
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: KING LEO area 19, Royal Pool, STATE 0 before repairs. Generate one portrait 9:16 environment still. The input is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the approved gate's warm royal 3D animation quality, but create this DIFFERENT location.
STYLE: Premium warm royal 3D animated-film environment: rounded bevelled cream sandstone, honey oak, polished brass, royal blue and gold, vivid healthy greenery, warm sunlight, clean dimensional materials. Bright cartoon colour, no gritty photorealism, no gloomy brown wash. Portrait 9:16, fixed camera, readable repair subjects, no UI or typography.
SCENE AND ALL INITIAL DAMAGE: Royal outdoor pool court enclosed by cream palace arcades and blue roofs, bright golden daylight. Small central basin filled with murky green water, visible broken turquoise rim tiles, damaged small pump house at rear right, chipped cream columns beside pool, debris-choked sluice gates at rear left, broken low diving platform at far end, cracked poolside paving in foreground, unlit brass pool lamps at sides. No swimmers or people, charming stylized neglect.
COMPOSITION: fixed slightly elevated three-quarter camera, fit the entire small room or courtyard into one portrait composition, broad readable shapes, keep every listed repair subject visible and spatially separated. No collage or cutaway panels. Main room occupies central 75%, a quiet foreground floor or path occupies lower 20%, architecture visible above. Clear 3D depth, soft shadows and ambient occlusion; materials are smooth but detailed, not plastic toys. The space needs repair but is still cheerful, sunlit, colourful and inviting.
LATER repairs, NONE done yet, in this exact order: 1. Drain the pool; 2. Repair the tile work; 3. Fix the pump house; 4. Restore the columns; 5. Clear the sluice gates; 6. Repair the diving platform; 7. Re-lay the poolside stone; 8. Relight the pool lamps.
Do not add living characters unless explicitly required. No UI, labels, readable words, logos, watermark, floating icons, particles, construction workers or tools being operated. One standalone portrait image with no border.
